title: Operationalisation framework for observing adaptive practices in clinical settings

description: The article argues that effect-of-instruction studies fail when instruction is merely given a methods label.
title: Operationalization and description of instructional treatments in effect-of-instruction research

description: A methodological framework in which robotic-platform OPIs are binned by month, reduced with t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding, and compared across consecutive time bins using \"Euclidean distance between consecutive bins\" weighted by days elapsed and case volume, then smoothed.
title: OPI-derived weighted-distance learning-curve analysis
